name: Indomitable
source: PFS Guide to Organized Play 6.0 pg. 15
body:
Drawbacks
Indomitable
Source PFS Guide to Organized Play 6.0 pg. 15
Category Faction
Your strong, self-reliant swagger has made you more resistant to domination and control. You gain a +1 trait bonus on saving throws versus enchantment spells and effects.
